findings.claim: Comissões exposes an unusable proposal-creation action when Orçamentos is disabled.
findings.evidence: An in-memory Node evaluation of the actual navigation and header code with orcamentos=false, comissoes=true returned a valid /operacional/comissoes route, header='Nova proposta', and clickedHeader={mode:'create'}, while modulesAllowCapability(modules,'proposals') returned false. The header renders this button without another capability check. Users can therefore enter the wizard but cannot save because POST /sales returns 403 edition_capability.
findings.suggestion: Gate the proposal header action on the orcamentos module. Add a shell regression case for comissoes=true and orcamentos=false.

findings.claim: The commission balance card follows Orçamentos instead of Comissões.
findings.evidence: The card uses hasCapability(edition,'commissions'), but editionFromModules depends only on orcamentos. The Node probe confirmed the card is hidden with orcamentos=false/comissoes=true and visible with orcamentos=true/comissoes=false.

findings.claim: The binding D6 shell-level drop regression test is missing.
findings.evidence: The test replaces LeadsBoardContainer with an empty div and never exercises dropping onto Proposta with orcamentos disabled. Slice 12's binding addendum explicitly requires proving that this interaction moves the lead without requesting conversion. The pure mapper test covers only part of that path.
findings.suggestion: Add the required interaction test through the shell and board wiring.
